mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_metadata (doc_id, file_name, file_type, page_count, upload_time, equipment_type, status, source_type, credibility_weight, persist_to_knowledge_base, is_temporary, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{docId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{pageCount}, #{uploadTime}, #{equipmentType}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{credibilityWeight}, #{persistToKnowledgeBase}, #{isTemporary}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE document_metadata SET file_name = #{fileName}, file_type = #{fileType}, page_count = #{pageCount}, upload_time = #{uploadTime}, equipment_type = #{equipmentType}, status = #{status}, source_type = #{sourceType}, credibility_weight = #{credibilityWeight}, persist_to_knowledge_base = #{persistToKnowledgeBase}, is_temporary = #{isTemporary}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT equipment_type FROM document_metadata WHERE equipment_type IS NOT NULL AND equipment_type != ''
